completeOriginalProcedureUnchanged: KEEP the ordinary Concordant Mindlink identity and willing minds. SOURCE GAP: no exact-name Core entry exists; the possible Rary's Telepathic Bond alias has Action/60feet/Instantaneous/V/S/F and matching summary,but remains separate historical evidence. NEW explicitly choose Action,initial60feet,V/S/F and concentration up toONE HOUR for the current identity. Choose two through eight conscious willing creatures including the caster,each individually perceived within60feet and line of effect at resolution. Meaningful voluntary agreement is required; ally status,absence of speech or incapacity is not consent. All form one fixed roster; no silent additional join/replacement during the hour. One Concordant Mindlink per participant across all casters. A creature already linked must genuinely withdraw from the old link before accepting a new one; failure/countering the new cast does not restore its withdrawn prior membership. Once established,each conscious participant within one mile of the original conscious concentrating caster on the same plane may voluntarily send one mental message per own regular-turn cycle,or one per six elapsed seconds outside initiative,up to25ordinary spoken words or a comparably brief simple idea. Extra turns do not reset this source communication allowance. Sending costs no Action beyond ordinary brief communication,but must be a genuine voluntary thought and requires actual capability; silence affecting ordinary sound alone does not prevent an already-established mental message. Choose any subset of the fixed eligible roster for each message,including the caster. NEW semantic comprehension needs no shared spoken language for concepts the sender actually understands and can ordinarily express; it grants no language proficiency,grammar,secret code comprehension,unknown factual translation or complicated sensory/memory download. No raw shared sight/hearing,map feed,mind reading,unspoken thoughts,compulsion,truth check,spell effect,verbal component substitute or remote targeting permission is transmitted. A sender can lie or decline; recipients retain agency. Actual source-qualified magical communication/information protection can prevent reception within its own scope,without disclosing why. A recipient outside continuing range,unconscious,on another plane,suppressed or withdrawn does not receive a message; it is not queued for return and the sender gains no automatic location/status acknowledgment. Ordinary chosen replies are independent messages with their sender's own real allowance. Range is measured to the original caster,not extended by chaining participants into a relay mesh; one mile here is5280feet. A temporarily ineligible but still-member conscious creature can communicate again when the actual gates return before the original hour expires,without a new clock. Any conscious participant may withdraw their own membership at any time by deliberate intent without an Action; a withdrawn member cannot rejoin this same application. Caster withdrawal,concentration loss,actual caster incapacity/death,expiry or removal ends the whole link; another member's death ends only their membership. Suppression of a participant blocks that participant's messaging,while a suppressed caster/link anchor blocks the link for all as its source scope requires. It does not create delayed messages or a channel after concentration ends. No persistent ability,class spell,alias-based second grant or cross-plane communication survives.

INFO131-LINK: NEW all-or-nothing admission. Every originally selected2..8 member, including caster, must still satisfy consent/consciousness/perception/60ft/LoE/no-other-membership at resolution; one failure establishes no surviving-subset link and refunds no costs. Withdrawal from an old link is a real deliberate act BEFORE new commitment and never reverses on counter/failure. After establishment the original roster IDs remain fixed historical records; withdrawn/dead memberships cannot silently rejoin.
NEW first/send clock: each member gets one entitlement on establishment in its current original regular-turn cycle, with the immutable original owner6sec cadence recorded. At the next original regular/virtual START boundary that entitlement becomes one fresh current entitlement; unused entitlements never accumulate. Outside initiative use the same6sec boundaries; reordering/entering/leaving or extra turns never issues another entitlement or resets used history. A genuine valid voluntary send to any chosen fixed-roster subset consumes that one current entitlement before independent delivery gates, even if every chosen recipient is absent/out-of-range/suppressed/withdrawn. No automatic acknowledgment, failure reason, hidden roster update or backlog is shown. A suppressed sender has no operative sending permission; returning preserves the actual clock/use history. Caster anchor suppression blocks all; participant-only suppression blocks that participant. These are source-local communication choices, not a generic Message word cap or global resource law.
